about: Prompt table for tools/regen-v1-tiles.cjs: one entry per V1 biome. Text-to-image entries regenerate the approved basis (slot 0 = basis seed, slots 1-3 = variantSeeds). Entries with `parent` apply one kontext edit to the new square of parent slot n. `source`: approved = prompt and seed of the approved basis; approved edit = the approved kontext prompt and seed; reconstructed = written from the approved look because V1 got it from a chain, a grade or a procedural layer. `origin` says where it came from. variantSeeds = seed + n*100003 (rerolled slots +7, listed in `rerolled`). Optional: `variantPrompt` (prompt for slots 1-3), `slotOverrides` (a slot made as a kontext edit of the biome's own slot `fromSlot`), `centerCrop` (use only the centre of a larger generation), `sdClamp` (grade contrast limits), `adjusted` + `firstTry` (one prompt correction after review), `flatten`/`grade` (post-processing switches).
